messages:
riley: Heads-up 1: Fulcrum12b (int4) started OOMing under long-lived chat sessions (~30-60 turns) on dedicated hosts. Happens more on routes with sticky sessions.

Tom_k: repro? sample commands/logs?

riley: repro: 
```\nredwoodctl perf run --model fulcrum12b --quant int4 --batch 4 --concurrency 150 --session_mode sticky --max_new_tokens 2048\n```
Logs show GPU slab free oscillating, then OOM after ~45 turns for some sessions. KV cache size grows ~linear per turn, not reclaimed between sessions due to session affinity.

lina: interesting. we saw similar on a few other models when session affinity keeps cold KV around. any fragmentation?

riley: yes — heap-dump shows lots of small free slots (128/256B) and many pinned KV segments tied to session ids. Compactor runs but doesn't consolidate fast enough because pinned segments block merges.

Tom_k: ideas: session-aware KV trimming + per-route max_new_tokens heuristics. e.g. trim oldest session-kv when global KV > X, and cap per-session kv entries to Y tokens. Also adaptive max_new_tokens that lowers default when 95th percentile session length > threshold.

riley: built a quick patch for canary: 
- per_session_kv_cap = 8192 tokens
- global_kv_soft_limit = 64MB
- session_kv_eviction_policy = "lru_aged"
- max_new_tokens_route_policy: if route.session_turns_p95 > 40 -> default_max_new_tokens=512 else 1024

lina: plus prefetch tweak? aggressive prefetch tends to allocate early and increase fragmentation. set `prefetch_tokens=12` for canary.

riley: ran a 2h canary loadtest: 400 sticky sessions, 60m avg lifespan. Result: no OOMs, p95 latency +18ms, overall throughput steady. KV growth capped, slab free percent stable >22%.

qa-bot: quick eval summary: eval-suite (SQuAD, convQA, rouge-lite) shows quality parity vs baseline int4: delta BLEU/ROUGE < 0.5. Perplexity unchanged.

Tom_k: neat. what about edge cases where trimming evicts needed context? any regressions in long-dialog retrieval?

riley: we did focused tests: if session_kv_eviction_policy = lru_aged then recent N turns preserved; lost context only when sessions exceed cap by 2x. For those routes we proposed a route tag `long_dialog=true` that disables per-session cap and instead uses dedicated long-session pool (larger mem).

lina: rollout plan proposal:
1) push canary to dedicated pool `fulcrum-12b-session-canary` (owner: riley)
2) 12h soak + regression eval (owner: lina)
3) instrument route metrics: `route.session_turns_p95`, `kv.global_bytes`, `gpu.slab.free_percent` (alerts at <15%) (owner: tom_k)
4) auto-adjust policy: enable adaptive max_new_tokens after 24h of stable metrics

infra-bot: Canary config deployed by tom_k at 3159990300 to pool fulcrum-12b-session-canary.

riley: commands to toggle/permanently set policies: 
- `redwoodctl config set --model fulcrum12b --per_session_kv_cap 8192`
- `redwoodctl route set --route long-dialog --model fulcrum12b --pool large-memory`
- `redwoodctl policy set --model fulcrum12b --adaptive_max_new_tokens true --p95_threshold 40 --low_default 512 --high_default 1024`

Tom_k: add emergency rollback: `redwoodctl config set --model fulcrum12b --per_session_kv_cap 0` (disable trimming) and `redwoodctl route set --model fulcrum12b --fallback int8 --threshold 0.9`. Documented?

lina: I'll own documentation + release note. QA will run full convQA sweep overnight.

riley: thanks team. If QA green, we flip adaptive policy on in 24-48h.

qa-bot: Scheduled tests: convQA-long-dialog (owner: lina) at 3159992000.

riley: :thumbsup:
